title_en: Mechanical & Electrical Unit Price Index: Sabah & Sarawak
title_ms: Indeks Harga Seunit Mekanikal & Elektrik: Sabah & Sarawak
description_en: Monthly unit price index of mechanical and electrical items for Sabah & Sarawak.
description_ms: Indeks harga seunit bulanan bagi item mekanikal dan elektrik bagi Sabah & Sarawak.
methodology_en: This data shows unit price indices for the mechanical and electrical components of building works: copper cables, switchgears, transformers, generators, lightning protection and earthing systems, air conditioning systems and pumpsets. The specifications are set by the Public Works Department (JKR) and the Construction Industry Development Board (CIDB). Prices for electrical components are collected every month; prices for other components are obtained from suppliers. The index is the reference for price variation in government contracts. Prices are reported for Sabah and Sarawak separately, except air conditioning systems and pumpsets, which are priced for Sabah and Sarawak together. It is on base January 2023 = 100, and is available from January 2023.
methodology_ms: Data ini menunjukkan indeks harga seunit bagi komponen mekanikal dan elektrik dalam kerja-kerja bangunan: kabel kuprum, suis gear, transformer, penjana, sistem perlindungan kilat dan pembumian, sistem penyaman udara dan set pam. Spesifikasi ditetapkan oleh Jabatan Kerja Raya (JKR) dan Lembaga Pembangunan Industri Pembinaan Malaysia (CIDB). Harga bagi komponen elektrik dipungut setiap bulan; harga bagi komponen lain diperoleh daripada pembekal. Indeks ini menjadi rujukan bagi perubahan harga dalam kontrak kerajaan. Harga dilaporkan bagi Sabah dan Sarawak secara berasingan, kecuali sistem penyaman udara dan set pam, yang dicerap bagi Sabah dan Sarawak secara bersama. Ia berasaskan Januari 2023 = 100, dan tersedia bermula Januari 2023.
caveat_en: The specifications of busducts, hermetically sealed transformers, generators, air conditioning systems and pumpsets are under review, so their indices may remain unchanged for long periods. Data for the most recent 12 months may be revised in subsequent releases.
caveat_ms: Spesifikasi bagi salur bas, transformer kedap hermetik, penjana, sistem penyaman udara dan set pam sedang dikaji semula, maka indeks bagi item tersebut mungkin kekal tidak berubah untuk tempoh yang panjang. Data bagi 12 bulan terkini mungkin disemak semula dalam penerbitan berikutnya.
publication_en: [Building Materials Cost Index, Sep 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/bc_2026-09), the latest edition of the monthly building materials cost statistics published by DOSM.
publication_ms: [Indeks Kos Bahan Binaan, Sep 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/bc_2026-09), edisi terkini bagi statistik kos bahan binaan bulanan yang diterbitkan oleh DOSM.
